beforeSelection: Two authored SmokeTests, not the upstream test suite.

cases.requirement: Whole-number conversion must preserve the parsed value.

review.author: agent
review.basis: Whole-number conversion must preserve the parsed value.

cases.before: int.TryParse(field.Text, styles, culture, out var value)

cases.requirement: Int32.MinValue must remain a valid whole-number value.

review.basis: Int32.MinValue must remain a valid whole-number value.
